title: Master of the Misty Waters - How to Earn & Missable Status (Phantom Blade Zero)
description: Master of the Misty Waters trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and rarity once the list is public.
keyword: Master of the Misty Waters phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: One trophy, three fights, all in the Meigu Lake region. Drops include the Loong Trident.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Defeat Blackwater Leader You Loong, Zither Maiden Yan Qiansui and the One-Eyed Archer.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This entry is filled from the shipped game on either platform; PS5 trophy and PC achievement lists are recorded separately where they differ. See the trophy guide for the full list and how long to beat for run-length context.
